_: The displays vrx boards drive: pixels, and the panel's width in mm (0 when its EDID gives none, and the runtime keeps the pixel ratio at 1.0). The one table: vrx_check (Dart) and vrx::kit (Rust) both read it. turns: vrx may show the panel turned a quarter, so an applet whose manifest declares orientation any is laid out at its turned shape too (plan 0013 D10).
